ownmods.gravestone.title: Gravestone
ownmods.gravestone.description: Stores death inventory in a paid grave chest.
ownmods.gravestone.enabled.tip: On death, create a grave chest when the inventory contains enough total chest/wood resources. Resources may be mixed.
ownmods.gravestone.single.tip: If a double chest cannot be paid for, create a single chest from at least 1 chest / 8 planks / 2 logs (mixed resources also count). Overflow stacks drop at the grave.
ownmods.gravestone.chat.tip: Show the dimension plus death and grave chest coordinates in chat.
ownmods.gravestone.created.double: Grave created in %s. Death: %s / %s / %s · Double chest: %s / %s / %s
ownmods.gravestone.created.single: Grave created in %s. Death: %s / %s / %s · Single chest: %s / %s / %s
ownmods.gravestone.overflow: %s item stacks did not fit and were dropped at the grave.
